messages:
Priya: quick morning recap — throwing this into the thread so day shift has context.

incident-bot: Pager triggered at 03:10 UTC -> service: hosted-api / route: /v1/generate / symptom: p95 token-latency spike and increased 503s.

Priya: tl;dr: transient kv-cache evictions in us-west caused synchronous miss storms for mid-length prompts. p95 went from ~280ms to ~1.3s for ~7m requests over an ~18m window. ~4 customers saw degraded responses (short generation timeouts -> 503). No data loss.

Tom: what was the immediate mitigation?

Priya: actions taken:
- rolled back recent autoscaler tweak (reduced min pods) at 03:18 -> reduced eviction frequency
- bumped cache pool size on us-west pool from 24->36 at 03:25
- temporarily enabled aggressive prefix caching for common prompt hashes
- applied a rate-limit soft-fail policy for non-SLA customers to protect tiered traffic

Priya: commands used (for reference):
```
# scale cache pool
k scale deployment/kv-cache-usw -n inference --replicas=36
# enable prefix caching toggle
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" https://config-console/api/toggles/enable --data '{"toggle":"prefix_cache_aggressive","env":"prod-us-west"}'
```

Jordan: saw the surge on traces — root cause looks like a combination of a model rollout with longer context and a small autoscaler min setting. I pushed a note to the rollout owner to pin model v2.3.1 until we complete the mem-profile change.

Niamh: verified customer impact list and contacted CS for the three affected accounts — they were notified at 03:45 with mitigation steps and a promise of a follow-up postmortem.

Tom: primary/secondary for day shift?

Priya: Day primary: Tom (you)
Day secondary: Jordan
On-call rotation notes: I'm handing over as night primary -> day passback. Secondary coverage window 08:00-20:00 PST.

Tom: thanks — any remaining risks?

Priya: current status:
- p95 back to ~320ms in us-west as of 03:55 (dashboard: <https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/kv-cache?env=us-west|kv-cache dashboard>)
- error-rate down to baseline; 503s reduced from 0.6% -> 0.02%
- scaling change reverted to safer defaults; rolling mem-profile changes scheduled for 10:00 UTC
- open follow-ups: model rollout pin + autoscaler tuning PR + long-term cache sizing techdebt

Next steps (actionable):
- Tom: monitor p95 & 503s for first 90m and escalate to eng-runtime if trend reappears. Add a 30-min check-in message here at 09:30 local.
- Jordan: open PR with autoscaler min/max recommendations and link perf-test logs.
- Niamh: coordinate customer follow-up and send postmortem draft by EOD.
- Priya: draft incident timeline + add to incident tracker (INC-2026-045) and link runbook pointers.

Runbooks / links:
- kv-cache eviction runbook: https://playbooks.local/runbooks/kv-cache-eviction
- autoscaler tuning doc: https://confluence.redwood/eng/autoscaler-guidance
- incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood/INC-2026-045

Coverage gaps: none expected for next 8h. If Tom needs relief, ping @Niamh or @Jordan.

Tom: ack — I'll paste a short status update to #ops-status in 10.

ops-bot: Reminder: add 'customer-communication' tag to INC-2026-045.

Priya: handing over to Tom now. Good luck and ping me if anything spikes. :coffee: 

Tom: taking over, thanks Priya. starting monitoring loop.

Jordan: leaving a short note in the rollout ticket to prevent accidental restarts.

Niamh: will send customer follow-ups by 09:00.

incident-bot: Thread closed by Priya at 04:05 UTC — follow-ups assigned.
